name: Custom Excel / Google Sheets Tool Built for You in 48 Hours — Tracker, Calculator, Dashboard or Data Clean-up
summary: A working spreadsheet built to your spec in 48 hours — formulas, dropdowns, dashboard, how-to. One revision included.
description_html:
Tell me what you're tracking and how you want to see it. Within 48 hours you receive a working spreadsheet with formulas, dropdowns, a dashboard and a one-page how-to — built to your spec, formula-checked, ready in Excel or Google Sheets.

Good fits: client/invoice trackers, pricing or quote calculators, inventory and COGS trackers, KPI dashboards from a CSV export, cleaning up a messy sheet into something that actually calculates.

Includes one revision round. Not a fit: macros/VBA, connections to live databases, tax filings.
custom_receipt: Thanks! Reply to your receipt email with: (1) what the sheet needs to track, (2) a sample of your data if you have one, (3) how you'd like the output to look (a screenshot or a sentence is fine). You'll have a first version within 48 hours.
